text:
Anika: Heads-up — commitments review scheduled for Monday. I'm seeing p4d reserved capacity utilization drift in eu-west over the last 6 weeks. Need a quick recommendation on whether we shift commitment, do a partial convert, or let some expire.

Jorge: +1. Can you paste the utilization numbers? rough percentages are fine.

Priya: Pulled a quick query from billing this morning, fwiw:
```
-- billing summary for p4d family (last 30d)
region       reserved_coverage
us-west-2    82%
eu-west-1    48%
ap-southeast-1 19%
```
eu-west has dropped because of a couple of long-running eval jobs moving back to hosted.

Tom: Oof. 48% on eu-west is low for committed capacity. What's the break-even if we convert to Savings Plan vs RI?

Anika: CostBot ran a model last week, attaching the quick outputs from cost-sim: 
BillingBot: simulation-id=sim-2026-03-03-88
Anika: Key points from the sim: converting 40% of eu-west reserved to a flexible compute SP saves ~17% vs on-demand for our combo of bursty + steady traffic. Keeping hard RIs gives better unit price but higher risk if traffic keeps falling.

Jorge: Can we rebalance regionally? e.g., shift some reservation from us-west-2 (where coverage is 82%) to eu-west if cloud provider supports region exchange or instance family reallocation?

Priya: We can't reassign across regions for classical RIs. Two options: 1) Sell/return RIs in us-west (painful), 2) let eu-west RIs expire and replace with Savings Plans or convertible RIs on renewal.

Tom: What about a short-term workaround: restrict some job schedulers to use on-demand in eu-west and batch heavier work into us-west where we have spare reserved capacity? That buys time until renewal.

Anika: Agree. Immediate game plan: (a) Pause non-critical eval jobs in eu-west for 2 weeks, (b) update scheduler affinity to prefer us-west for batch, (c) finalize renewal recommendation by next Wed with numbers.

Jorge: For the renewal doc I'll need: current amortized hourly cost, committed vs observed usage (by day), and projected 12-month demand. Priya — can you attach the daily delta CSV?

Priya: Uploading CSV to the shared folder now: /infra/costs/p4d_eu-west_daily_delta.csv. It has columns: date, reserved_hours, used_hours, spot_hours, on_demand_hours.

BillingBot: Reminder: convertible RIs have a 1-2% conversion fee and can take up to 24h to reflect in billing. Savings Plans apply across regions for compute-type SPs — might help us consolidate.

Tom: Also run the sensitivity for -10% traffic and +15% traffic scenarios. We need to avoid a costly mis-commit.

Anika: Will do. I'll prepare a short deck with three clear options: keep & wait, convert to compute SP (partial), or aggressive downsize + scheduler shift. Slides due Tue EOD.

Jorge: I'll draft the recommendation template and include the ROI calc.

Priya: FYI: there's a scheduled deploy Mon 02:00 UTC that may spike short term. I'll coordinate to avoid adding noise to the usage signals.

Tom: Thanks. tagging @finance and @sre for visibility in the follow-up doc. :eyes:

Anika: Cool — if nobody objects, we'll act on the immediate scheduler changes today to reduce eu-west pressure. :thumbsup:
